tripSettings.title: Trip settings
tripSettings.cover.pick: Pick a cover photo: tap a photo <arrow></arrow> “Set as cover”
tripSettings.cover.none: No photos yet. Later, tap one <arrow></arrow> “Set as cover”
tripSettings.name: Name
tripSettings.color.label: Colour on the globe & map
tripSettings.notOwner: Only the organiser can change the trip settings.
tripSettings.guest: You're a guest on this trip: you can view it, not change it.
tripSettings.photos.noLocation: {summary}. Note: without access to the location in your photos, they won't show on the map.
tripSettings.sync.helpLocal: Looks in your photo library for photos taken on the days of this trip and puts them in the timeline. If a photo has a location, it goes on the map too.
tripSettings.sync.helpImmich: Looks in Immich for photos taken on the days of this trip and puts them in the timeline. If a photo has a location, it goes on the map too.
tripSettings.sync.bodyLocal: Searches your photo library for photos from these trip days.
tripSettings.sync.bodyImmich: Fetch new photos from Immich for this trip.
tripSettings.device.title: Photos on this device
tripSettings.device.help: Searches your gallery for photos from these trip days and puts them in your timeline and on the map, without uploading them. They then live only on this device: your travel companions don't see them, they're not part of a share link, and they won't be there on a new phone. The photos themselves simply stay in your gallery.
tripSettings.device.count_one: {count} photo from this device in this trip.
tripSettings.device.count_other: {count} photos from this device in this trip.
tripSettings.device.empty: From your gallery, without sending them to the server.
tripSettings.device.unlinkBody: The photos themselves simply stay in your gallery. They only disappear from this trip.
tripSettings.marker.title: Dot on the globe
tripSettings.marker.help: On the globe, this trip has a dot at its start and its end. Here you can put a single dot on a spot you choose instead, with the name tag on it. Handy for a round trip, where the start and end are so close together that they say nothing.
tripSettings.marker.move: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
tripSettings.marker.choose: Drag the pin or tap the map to choose the spot.
tripSettings.tracking.title: Tracking
tripSettings.tracking.nowBody: Start or stop tracking your route for this trip.
tripSettings.tracking.nowEnded: This trip has ended. Tracking is still running and stops by itself, or now.
tripSettings.tracking.ended: This trip has ended, so it can't be tracked any more.
tripSettings.tracking.guest: You're a guest on this trip and can only follow along.
tripSettings.tracking.notAllowed: The organiser has turned tracking off for you.
tripSettings.tracking.autoBody: Starts tracking your route as soon as the trip begins (app, in the background).
tripSettings.facts.title: Facts on the cover
tripSettings.facts.help: There's room for four. If you don't pick any, the app takes the first four this trip has, in this order: distance, days, stops, photos, travel companions.
tripSettings.danger.tracked.title: Clear tracked data
tripSettings.danger.tracked.body: Removes your GPS route (the trip and photos stay). Pick a day, or clear everything.
tripSettings.danger.tracked.confirmDay: Are you sure you want to delete the tracking from {day}? This can't be undone.
tripSettings.danger.tracked.confirmAll: Are you sure you want to delete ALL tracked data from this trip? This can't be undone.
tripSettings.danger.routes.title: Clear automatically drawn routes
tripSettings.danger.routes.body: Only removes the routes you drew with <path></path>. Your own tracked GPS stays.
tripSettings.danger.routes.confirmBody: Only the automatically drawn routes (along roads) are deleted. Your own tracked GPS stays.
